name: Isometric Picture Book
summary: A calm, full-bleed true-isometric place in flat three-tone paper colours: small faceless people seen from behind keep to a rule in order, marks on the ground show the way, and serif words land on the floor one character at a time. One persimmon accent, only where the rule is.

palette.use: the paper ground: every ground, warm neutral
paper light: lid undersides, the caption bar
the pale ghost a floor character fades from
persimmon, reserved for the rule: the key character, stand-here outlines, the winning number
the subject hue of this place: blue light, seats (proposed for the sample; the source's demo place is green)
persimmon's light tint: the shorter floor bar
the sixth spectrum lane (the source's subject green)
tone target: top faces lift 22% toward it
tone target: +x faces drop 20% toward warm umber

type.emphasis: one accent character or number per phrase, in persimmon

banned: a floating board, dot lattice, sans-serif pins, icon stats or inset bubbles (that's the infographic)
lighting, faceted terrain, shadows or glow; expressions or gags; headers, centred titles or cards
faces or hands; people walking toward the camera; people passing through seats, walls or each other
outlines, shadows, textures or highlight spots on solids; shading toward grey or violet; gradients
zigzag paths or serpentine crowds; high seat backs hiding seated people
the accent as decoration, or an accent trail across the whole film
page turns, wipes, black frames; type standing behind raised objects; flat sign cards facing the lens; a sentence on the floor
copying any reference explainer's characters, layouts, typefaces or music
